03

Meticulous preparation
The craftsmanship condensed behind the light and shadow.


Casual behind-the-scenes photos of daily creation. Photo by Xue Yunhui.


Behind this feast of technology and art is the culmination of countless efforts. This project specially invitesLi Ge, Vice Chairman of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles and President of the China Photographers AssociationAs the overall planner, we will present the achievements of scientific and technological innovation in an artistic form, using artistic expression to break down the public's cognitive barriers towards technology companies, and strengthen the urban image of the 'Eastern Shenzhen Science and Innovation Center' and the 'Bay Area Innovation Engine'.


In March 2025, Li Ge launched the first session of the Greater Bay Area grassroots photography backbone workshop in Shenzhen with the 'High-Quality Image Creation Precision Training Program'.


Casual behind-the-scenes photos of daily creation. Photo by Xue Yunhui.


Li Ge combines his decades of creative experience to guide students to break through technical constraints and directly address the essence of photography.In practice, leading the trainees into the streets of Longgang District on weekdays, in the dawn and the afternoon high-tech parks, providing hands-on teaching of composition aesthetics and narrative logic, as well as reviewing and guiding their works. During this period, we also visited 11 artificial intelligence, new materials, and robotics companies in Longgang District for on-site creation.









Casual behind-the-scenes photos of daily creation. Photo by Xue Yunhui.


On August 1, 2025, the project team held its second face-to-face planning meeting. They established the regional distribution of the four major themes of the exhibition, reviewed the preliminary selected exhibition works, determined the direction for the supplementary and improvement of the next photography content, and engaged in detailed discussions on the diversification of exhibition forms. Li Ge suggested that while adhering to the exhibition layout standards of the art museum, efforts should be made to incorporate new materials and forms to not only align with the thematic expression of the exhibition but also to create a striking impression, making the exhibition more innovative.


Team discussion on the curation plan. Photo by Li Bing.
